title: Memory
subtitle: Control background memory extraction and host scanning cadence.

global.extractEveryEligibleTurns: How often to update global memory
global.extractEveryEligibleTurnsDesc: Update agentic_os memory once every N eligible conversations.
global.minExtractIntervalMinutesDesc: Set to 0 to disable the cooldown.
global.forceExtractAfterPendingEligibleTurnsDes: Set to 0 to disable this override. Otherwise, auto memory runs immediately once pending eligible turns reach this threshold, even if the cooldown has not expired.

workspace.extractEveryEligibleTurns: How often to update workspace memory
workspace.extractEveryEligibleTurnsDesc: Update workspace memory once every N eligible conversations.
workspace.minExtractIntervalMinutesDesc: Set to 0 to disable the cooldown.
workspace.forceExtractAfterPendingEligibleTurnsDes: Set to 0 to disable this override. Otherwise, auto memory runs immediately once pending eligible turns reach this threshold, even if the cooldown has not expired.

resetDialog.title: Reset memory settings?
resetDialog.message: Global memory, workspace memory, and host scan settings will return to their defaults.

enable.label: Enable background auto scan
enable.description: Periodically refresh the host overview in a background Agentic OS session. If the file is missing or empty, the first attempt waits 10 minutes.

interval.label: Regular scan interval
interval.description: When the host overview already exists and is non-empty, refresh it on this cadence

messages.loadFailed: Failed to load host scan settings
messages.saveFailed: Failed to save host scan settings

messages.disableAllSuccess: Auto memory and host scan disabled
messages.enableAllSuccess: Auto memory and host scan enabled
